WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM fees
  WHERE orderslink IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.orderslink,
    s1.group_avg,
    s1.cnt,
    s1.group_avg - s2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.group_avg > s2.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) as avg_group_average,
  AVG(cnt) as avg_count,
  AVG(diff) as avg_difference
FROM step3
